brief: A small display stand: three bases meeting at a corner with a raised platform on a spike at that corner.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Compact cluster of 3x hex bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) with house rules applied (capOpenFaces, lockJoints). BOM: 3 hex bases, 12 edge caps, mount spike + large platform.

requirements.requirement: Three bases meeting at a corner
requirements.evidence: Bases at 0,0,0 / 0,1,0 / 1,0,0 share common junction 0#0,0|0,1|1,0 – the classic 3-way corner where a spike can stand. Verified by spike offer s14 at that junction.

requirements.requirement: Raised platform on a spike at that corner
requirements.evidence: Spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 fitted as mount variant (addSpike variant mount) and carrying platform-lrg accessory via setSpikeAccessory. Platform sits above the corner junction, creating raised display surface.

finish.summary: Built 3-base corner cluster with mount spike + large platform at the shared junction. Verified mesh clear, caps and joint bolts fitted.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
